name: Zombie
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

description: A zombie shambles forward with grim, unthinking persistence, held together by dark magic and driven only by the last command it was given.
